title: Quarterly Hosted API Model Rotation Playbook and Promotion Schedule
creator: Marisol Vega
description: A playbook and schedule to coordinate quarterly rotations of models available on the Hosted API (promotions, deprecations, and capacity-bound rollouts). The goal is to make upgrades predictable for customers, reduce surprise performance regressions, and codify evaluation gates and rollback triggers. The doc should include: decision criteria for promotions (latency, quality, cost delta, telemetry signal thresholds), deprecation windows and customer communication templates, automated canary rollout plan with traffic weighting, required QA/eval checklist, owner matrix, and runbook for emergency rollback. This ticket captures PM work to draft the playbook, align with runtime and eng on implementation hooks, and schedule the Q2 rotation milestones.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Created initial ticket. Scoped deliverables and owners. Noted dependencies on ENG-6123 (canary routing) and ENG-7180 (model telemetry exports).

2026-02-25 - Met with Runtime and Observability teams. Decided to require both token-latency 95th and generation-quality delta < 1.5% on core eval set for promotion. Runtime requested a phased rollout API flag to control traffic weights.

2026-03-03 - Drafted customer comms templates for 'beta promotion' and 'scheduled deprecation' (link in attachments). PM proposed 30/30/30 deprecation schedule: 30 days beta, 30 days general availability, 30 days deprecation notice + opt-out window.

2026-03-08 - Eng feedback: need automatable rollback triggers based on rate of hallucination increase as measured by eval harness; research to define metric (ENG-7392). Added requirement for pre- and post-rollout A/B evals using production prompts sample.
2026-03-12 - Design requested templated dashboard for per-model rollout metrics. Prod design sync scheduled week of 2026-03-16.
2026-03-14 - Finalize playbook draft and share with leadership; move ticket to Planned. Dependencies consolidated and handoff tasks created for implementation phase.
